findings.summary: Backend proxy path segment validation duplicates the red asset proxy segment policy.
findings.consequence: Future path-hardening changes can diverge between API proxying and red asset proxying, especially around unsafe segment classes and percent-decoding behavior.
findings.evidence: safeBackendPath rejects empty, dot, dot-dot, backslash, and C0/DEL control characters before encodeURIComponent. The red route independently implements the same segment-level responsibility in server/routes/red/[...path].ts via hasUnsafePathSegment/safeProxySegment, with a stricter shared text-safety helper for C1 controls and lone surrogates.
findings.recommendation: Extract a shared path-segment validator/encoder for proxy paths, parameterized by the caller-specific error message or error factory, then use it from both backend-proxy and red proxy code.
